scope: Read-only review, AST parse and in-memory counterexample; seal/prepare-sources/real verify NOT executed

findings.finding: verify accepts an empty/truncated manifest and returns GO with zero verified files; no comparison against prior archived digest or expected inventory
findings.evidence: Executed verify only against an in-memory empty manifest; no real manifest touched

counterexampleObserved.localDecision: GO PARA CANDIDATO LOCAL DE ENTREGA

findings.requestedCorrection: Require strict SHA/path format, nonempty unique canonical entries and exact inventory; compare digest to prior closure proof where present; fail on omissions without repair/regeneration

findings.finding: Signature guard trusts JSON digests without hashing current acta.sig/public DER; independent proof checked only by filename existence
findings.requestedCorrection: Require exact verification result/classification; SHA256 of actual signature+DER; parse independent proof and bind result, document, signature and certificate hashes to same current acta and candidate signer

findings.finding: Only hygiene manifest is sealed; archived residual files it references are neither included nor recursively verified
findings.requestedCorrection: Include hygiene backup files or verify nested manifest during seal and every verify; preserve original manifest bytes

findings.finding: Nine lots and 12local/6field criteria checked by counts; duplicated/wrong IDs satisfy those checks
findings.requestedCorrection: Require exact unique L00..08 IDs, local CI01..12, field CI04/05/06/07/10/11; validate top-level pilot false and NO_GO_PILOTO_REAL

findings.finding: Private exclusion checks lexical .local path parts and .private suffix; no explicit private directories, keystore/DPAPI or reparse/symlink escape guard
findings.requestedCorrection: Fail closed on resolved outsideROOT, reparse/symlink ancestors and secret extensions; explicitly permit public certificate/signature files
